description: This file defines the 'ResourceObserver' class which serves as a base class implementing the observer pattern for resource management within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes class properties, a constructor, and methods for setting limits and notification handling.

classes.name: ResourceObserver
classes.description: Base class for implementing observer/observable pattern in resource management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the observer with a module name.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit parameter for the observer.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Handles notification, either by terminating or outputting an error message based on the dieOnError property.
